slides.text: Glance Pay — hands-free stablecoin payments on Even Realities G2 smart glasses. Built for the Heads Up hackathon, DeFi track.
The G2 puts a private monochrome display in everyday eyewear. No camera, no speaker — just three lines of green text and a ring for input.
Tap the glasses or R1 ring to listen. Say: pay twelve fifty to Blue Tokai. Raw microphone PCM streams to our backend for speech-to-text, then a parser extracts amount and merchant.
GPS on the phone sorts merchants by distance. Scroll the ring or temple to choose. Tap to confirm. No auto-pay — every transaction is explicit.
The confirm screen shows merchant, rupees, and USDC equivalent on one glanceable line. One tap on the glasses or R1 ring authorizes payment.
Our backend signs a real test USDC transfer on Ethereum Sepolia using a demo wallet, then polls for the on-chain receipt.
Verification checks: transaction succeeded, went to the USDC contract, Transfer event credits the treasury, amount matches. Then Resend emails the receipt.
The phone panel mirrors the lens, shows wallet balances, and speaks the result. Payment of rupees twelve fifty to Blue Tokai confirmed.
Admin tab: onboard new merchants with name, GPS coordinates, UPI URI, and category. All payments are verifiable on-chain with Etherscan links.
Smart defaults remember your last payment. Next glance: tap, tap, done. Glance Pay — real on-chain settlement, hands-free on G2.
